blocked=[]
for i in range(32,127):
    ch=chr(i)
    q=urllib.parse.quote(ch)
    try:
        r=urllib.request.urlopen("http://web:5000/page?name="+q, timeout=5)
        body=r.read().decode('utf-8','replace')
    except Exception as e:
        blocked.append((ch,'ERR'+str(e))); continue
    if "Sorry you can't use" in body:
        blocked.append(ch)
print("BLOCKED chars:", [c for c,_ in [(b,'') for b in blocked]])
print("count:", len([b for b in blocked if not isinstance(b,tuple)]))
